brief:
The Metropolitan Police determined Saturday that a social media post by Sarah Helm backing the proscribed group Palestine Action did not constitute a criminal offense, Middle East Eye reported. Helm is married to the British prime minister's national security adviser.

The ruling follows public controversy over the post, which expressed support for an organization designated as prohibited under British law.

title: Met Police clears PM adviser's wife over Palestine Action post
